hypothesis: Each keystroke/scroll re-renders more of the transcript than needed (full reflow of the visible window, re-wrapping unchanged rows, per-cell redraw); a parity-safe dirty-region/cached-line rendering fix cuts typing latency on large sessions.
approach: REFUTED AT PROFILING STAGE - no code change, no candidate build. Evidence chain: (1) Code audit of the f2c02ade0 render path: the proposed mechanism is ALREADY the architecture - crates/pa-tui/src/view/lazy.rs SparseWindow (only visible sections materialize; tail-anchored walk), view/layout.rs EntryLayout per-entry row cache keyed (width, detail, spacing) + entry_heights wrap-count cache + md_caches markdown block cache keyed by width, interactive.rs inline paint per handled key with a 16ms coalescing gate, ratatui double-buffer cell diff. (2) perf profile (perf 5.15 on kernel 6.16, -F 199, 45s window) of the shipped base binary under the bench's exact scenario (resume 10MiB fixture, sentinel wait, typed token, 5x PageUp, 30-event SGR wheel burst, typing while scrolled): app CPU ~0.4% of one core; top self symbols are idle waits (futex, epoll, timerfd); ratatui Span::render_ref = 18% of a 92-sample window - the per-keystroke render work is microseconds. (3) Session-size independence probe (PTYSession driver, 120x40, mock provider, same launch shape as the adapter): fresh session vs 10MiB-loaded session typing per-key latencies are statistically identical - fresh: p50~0.8ms with 2-10.4ms idle-wake spikes; loaded: p50~0.5ms with 2-12.2ms spikes; typing_scrolled loaded: p50~0.55ms. The spikes appear equally on fresh sessions => they are CPU idle-wake/scheduler artifacts, not transcript-size render cost. (4) pty_bytes for the whole interaction phase: 12.4KB (loaded) / 8.3KB (fresh) in probes; 75-89KB in official trials (incl. the sentinel frames) - the paint pipeline already emits only changed cells. (5) Official 5-trial suites on the base VM (below) put typing_ms p50 at 1.53ms with the harness noop-control floor at p50 0.1ms; the residual app-side per-cell buffer render (~120x40 cells/paint, session-size independent) bounds ANY further dirty-region gain to well under the trial noise.
parity_notes: No code change: lane/hillclimb-tui-typing == base f2c02ade0 with zero commits (branch tip = origin/rust at fold time; later product merges do not touch this lane). The binary benchmarked is byte-identical to the base build (sha256 6b79f847a77badad97e7cb8d2c8188faef0cd1b09f99d7c0a491ffe121e9b6c3). Parity trivially preserved: same features, same session-JSONL content, same wire protocol, same platforms.

probe_evidence.conclusion: fresh-vs-loaded typing latency distributions identical within noise; spikes are idle-wake artifacts present on both.

decision: PENDING orchestrator; worker recommendation: DISCARD - the proposed dirty-region/cached-line rendering already exists on this base (sparse windows, per-entry row/height/markdown caches keyed by width, ratatui cell diff); typing latency is session-size independent (p50 1.53ms loaded vs identical fresh-session distribution); residual per-cell buffer render is microseconds and session-size independent, far under trial noise (cold_open spread 78% on one VM). No PR.
